text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Production in the engineering sector totalled 53.86 billion crowns in the first eight months of this year, compared with 44.54 billion in the same period of 1995. Exports totalled 32.44 billion crowns, up from 27.48 billion in January-August period last year.
- The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said the current system of eight reference banks is sufficient, and that it will continuously review the make up of the group and possibly revise it.
- The Zilina airport will issue a 50 million-crown tranche of bonds to cover modernisation project.

- Production at chemical company Chemosvit Svit totalled 1.76 billion crowns in the first half of this year, with exports totalling about 1.26 billion. The firm posted a pre-tax profit of 63.3 million crowns.

- The National Property Fund (NPF), the state privatisation agency, has approved privatisation of another 20 small state companies. The largest sale was a spa in the eastern town Bardejov for 210 million crowns. The overall volume of the selloff totalled around 833 million crowns.

- The official Statistical Bureau said it expected industrial production to be higher in October than in the previous month. SUSR said, according to preliminary figures, production rose in about 56 percent of Slovak companies.

NARODNA OBRODA - European Union ambassador to Slovakia Gergios Zavvos said Slovakia could get a 17 billion crown grant from the EU. Zavvos said that the EU condition was that the funds would only be used to support Slovakia's democratic reforms.
- The largest saving bank, Slovenska Sporitelna, now controls about 80 percent of the primary deposit market, managing some seven million accounts.
SME - The government said the next year budget will extend about 600 million crowns to help stabilise the situation on the domestic grain market.
